solutionSql:
SELECT e.shipment_id FROM shipment_events e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.shipment_id = e.shipment_id)
UNION
SELECT i.shipment_id FROM invoices i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_events e WHERE e.shipment_id = i.shipment_id)
ORDER BY shipment_id;
notes: Two NOT EXISTS branches joined by UNION give 49 rows; a FULL JOIN formulation returns the same rows.
